integrity: The universal homotopy equivalence follows from a simplicial pushout and nullhomotopy argument; finite prime-field computations are corroborative only. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only existing finite affine planes of order at least two, unweighted point-line graph distance, inclusive scale two; no existence result for unspecified orders and no assertion for other incidence geometries.
title: Mixed-dimensional Vietoris–Rips homotopy of affine-plane incidence graphs
